scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && tsx watch server/src/main.ts
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run version:check && npm run ui:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && npm run typecheck -w @pop-agent/web && tsc --noEmit -p tools
scripts.build: tsc -b && chmod +x server/dist/manager/main.js && npm run build -w @pop-agent/web
scripts.launcher:check: cd launcher && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.local-access:check: cd local-access/tray && test -z "$(gofmt -l *.go)" && go vet ./... && go test ./... && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /tmp/pop-local-access-gate.exe .
scripts.gate: tsx tools/gate-receipt.ts begin && npm run version:check && npm run pi-patch:check && npm run specs:check && npm run public:check && npm run selfmap:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run launcher:check && npm run local-access:check && npm run build && npm run test && npm run smoke && tsx tools/gate-receipt.ts complete
scripts.pack:cli: npm run version:check && tsx tools/pack-cli.ts && tsx tools/pack-node-runtime.ts
